title: YÖKDİL Sosyal Bilimler Mini Deneme 1
description: YÖKDİL sosyal bilimler formatına uygun kısa akademik İngilizce denemesi.

questions.questionText: The researcher attempted to ___ the relationship between language and social identity.
Cultural values may ___ how individuals communicate in professional settings.
The theory ___ by many scholars since the early twentieth century.
questions.explanation: 'Since' yapısı present perfect gerektirir. Ayrıca theory edilgen durumdadır.

questions.questionText: Because social interaction is shaped by cultural norms, ___.
options: communication styles may vary from one society to another
the experiment was conducted in a laboratory
the number of participants was limited
the article was published last year
questions.correctAnswer: communication styles may vary from one society to another
questions.explanation: Sebep-sonuç ilişkisi vardır. Kültürel normlar iletişim biçimlerinin toplumdan topluma değişmesine neden olabilir.

questions.questionText: The findings of the study are ___ with previous research on social behavior.
questions.explanation: 'Be consistent with' bir şeyle uyumlu olmak anlamına gelir.
